The '''Imperial data center''' was a data center operated by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] in [[Network Access]], part of the [[Network Security District]] of the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]].<ref name="TOR:NA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Imperial data center appears as part of Network Access on Nar Shaddaa in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]].<ref name="TOR:NA" />
